title: Live players
description: B11: what the web map answers to GET /api/players, as JSON: each world's live players, by name and where they were last seen. A world shows only while it has a live player. It carries no platform id and no session id. The request carries nothing and needs no session: without sign-in the web map is public and read-only (B9). While the web map cannot read the database it answers 503 in plain text instead.

worlds.description: Each world that has a live player.

name.description: The world's save name, as the manifest takes it. The pattern repeats schema/manifest.schema.json's save_name, which the web map's image does not ship, and widens with it.
The name the player chose, in one line of printable text. It need not be unique, and is null until intake takes their join.
